name: First Light
northStar: Make it feel like 7:30 on an Ericeira morning and put a thumb on Book within one scroll.

engine.source: Sunrise over a whitewashed Portuguese fishing town: warm low light, hard white walls, deep blue shadows.
engine.evidence: The report goes out at 7:30 each morning; most visitors browse on phones before arriving.

tone._why: Loud, friendly, big type: a tourist deciding on a phone should feel the place and the price at once.

change: Replace stock photo hero with a typographic poster in solid colour

skeleton: Persuasion poster: full-bleed colour field, giant headline top, one-line conditions pill, three price tickets stacked full-width at the bottom as the primary action.

color.from: Dawn coral on whitewash; Atlantic navy for type and tickets.

hero: Typographic: the headline 'Small waves. Big start.' at full width.
